mp._multiplayerState: A type of state to get for a player
mp.allPlayers: Returns an array of all players
mp.changePlayerStateBy: Changes the value of the specified player state
mp.changePlayerStateBy|param|delta: The amount to change the state by
mp.changePlayerStateBy|param|player: The player to change the state for
mp.getPlayerByIndex:
Gets the player by index

@returns Player, or undefined if not found
mp.getPlayerByIndex|param|index: The zero-based index of the player
mp.getPlayerByNumber:
Gets the player by number

@returns Player, or undefined if not found
mp.getPlayerByNumber|param|number: The one-based number of the player
mp.getPlayerBySprite:
Gets the player the sprite is assigned to

@returns Player, or undefined if not found
mp.getPlayerProperty:
Gets a property of the player


@returns The value of the property
mp.getPlayerProperty|param|player: The player to get the property of
mp.getPlayerSprite:
Gets the sprite of the player

@returns The sprite of the player, or undefined if the player has no assigned sprite
mp.getPlayerSprite|param|player: The player to get the sprite of
mp.getPlayerState:
Gets the value of the specified player state


@returns The value of the state
mp.getPlayerState|param|player: The player to get the state for
mp.isButtonPressed:
Queries the state of a button on a controller


@returns true if the button is pressed
mp.isConnected:
Queries the connected state of the player

@returns true if the player is connected
mp.moveWithButtons: Control a player's sprite with directional buttons
mp.moveWithButtons|param|vx: The horizontal velocity of the sprite (optional)
mp.moveWithButtons|param|vy: The vertical velocity of the sprite (optional)
mp.onButtonEvent: Runs code when a button on any controller is pressed, released, or held
mp.onButtonEvent|param|event: The event to listen for (pressed, released, or held)
mp.onButtonEvent|param|handler: The code to run when the button is pressed, released, or held
mp.onControllerEvent: Runs code when a controller is connected or disconnected
mp.onControllerEvent|param|event: The event to listen for (controller connected or disconnected)
mp.onControllerEvent|param|handler: Code to run when the event is raised
mp.onLifeZero: Runs code when a player's number of lives reaches zero
mp.onLifeZero|param|handler: The code to run when the lives reach zero
mp.onScore: Runs code once each time a player's score reaches a given value.
mp.onScore|param|handler: The code to run when the score is reached
mp.onScore|param|score: The score to check for, eg: 100
mp.playerSelector:
Selects one of the players by number

@returns The player
mp.setPlayerIndicatorsVisible: Turns player indicators on or off
mp.setPlayerSprite: Sets the sprite of the player
mp.setPlayerSprite|param|player: The player to set the sprite for
mp.setPlayerState: Sets the value of the specified player state
mp.setPlayerState|param|player: The player to set the state for
mp.setPlayerState|param|value: The value to set the state to
